controls.title: Logical access — least privilege
controls.description: Logical access to systems and data is restricted to authorized users based on least privilege and is reviewed periodically.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.description: MFA is enforced for all users accessing internal and customer-facing systems.

controls.title: Security monitoring & alerting
controls.description: Security events are logged, monitored, and alerts are triaged within defined SLAs.

controls.title: Incident response plan
controls.description: A documented incident response plan exists, is tested at least annually, and post-incident reviews are recorded.

controls.title: Cloud services security
controls.description: Security requirements for acquisition, use, and exit of cloud services are defined and managed.

controls.title: Technical vulnerability management
controls.description: Vulnerabilities are identified, evaluated, and remediated within risk-based timelines.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backups of information, software, and systems are maintained and tested per the backup policy.

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.description: Personnel receive security awareness training on hire and at least annually.

controls.title: Records of processing activities
controls.description: Records of processing activities (RoPA) are maintained and kept current for all personal data flows.

controls.title: Security of processing
controls.description: Appropriate technical and organizational measures (encryption, pseudonymization) protect personal data.

controls.title: Breach notification readiness
controls.description: Processes exist to detect, document, and notify supervisory authorities of breaches within 72 hours.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to infrastructure and applications follow a documented, reviewed, and approved process.
